title: Native Advertising: A Marketer’s Guide | illumin

facts.fact: Native advertising accounted for over 70% of total US display ad revenue in 2021, according to AppSamurai (a third-party source cited by the page).
facts.unit: % of total US display ad revenue
facts.quote: Accounting for over 70% of total US display ad revenue in 2021 (source: AppSamurai)

facts.fact: According to Outbrain (a third-party source cited by the page), consumers look at native ads 53% more than display ads.
facts.quote: Consumers look at native ads 53% more than display ads, and native ads create an 18% increase in purchase intent

facts.fact: According to Outbrain (a third-party source cited by the page), native ads create an 18% increase in purchase intent.
facts.quote: native ads create an 18% increase in purchase intent (Source: Outbrain)

facts.fact: According to the Native Advertising Institute (a third-party source cited by the page), a third of consumers were more likely to trust native advertising than traditional advertising.
facts.quote: A third of consumers were more likely to trust native advertising than traditional advertising

facts.fact: According to eMarketer (a third-party source cited by the page), US native display ad spending is expected to grow 12.5% year-over-year in 2023, reaching $98.59 billion.
facts.quote: Native display ad spending in the US is expected to grow 12.5% year-over-year in 2023, reaching $98.59 billion

facts.fact: According to Outbrain/Sevanta research (a third-party source cited by the page), 68% of consumers trust native ads seen in an editorial context.
facts.quote: 68% of consumers trust native ads seen in an editorial context, compared to 55% for social media ads

facts.fact: According to The Drum (a third-party source cited by the page), the native advertising sector is estimated to be worth $400bn by 2025.
facts.quote: The Native Advertising sector is estimated to be worth $400bn by 2025
